scope: The sole whole-token courtesy adverb ljubazno in the four Latin sources, at base line 6732; arbitrary-quantifier ljub- forms were already closed by EDIT-0103.
choice: Normalize the South-shaped surface ljubazno to the official type-1 Interslavic adverb ljubezno.
motivation: The sentence means that E. Fischer courteously permitted Noether to use unpublished theorems. Official ljubezno expresses that exact courtesy meaning and bridges East and South comparators without preserving a Croatian/Serbian-only surface in the maintained ISV layer.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining ljubazno was rejected because it is the Croatian/Serbian comparator supplied under the official entry, not the official ISV headword.
Mapping to ljubovoljno was rejected because arbitrary/optional is the wrong semantic class; EDIT-0103 deliberately excluded this occurrence from that family.
Using an analytic paraphrase such as s dobrotoju was rejected because the exact official adverb is available and preserves the concise German courtesy formula.
Deleting the adverb was rejected because German freundlichst explicitly contributes the courtesy meaning.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official dictionary SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842, ID 8908, gives type-1 ljubezno, adverb, with the meanings amiably, affably and courteously. Its national columns list Croatian/Serbian ljubazno as comparators while Bulgarian, Macedonian and Russian retain the ljubezn-/ljubez- bridge.
evidence.german_authority: Current German ED0014 noether.tex SHA-256 EE226847656BC4D65EDDA9E9BF9BB1D25797C0C6D672D267D94A97FD88C7AD58 line 5976 and the stable public German authority 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_WorkingSourceControl_P02_P04S07_20260718.tex, 2152414 bytes, SHA-256 8851AF561D7C40B2295DB5D4108684A06015756B9B6FDD7CCE67466E0F7F8134, line 5958 both read deren Verwendung mir dieser freundlichst gestattete, exactly supporting courteously permitted.
evidence.context: Base line 6732 credits E. Fischer, who allowed use of unpublished theorems; the adverb modifies dozvolil and has no mathematical arbitrary-quantifier sense.
evidence.cross_family_evidence: The official row records recognition across Bulgarian, Croatian, Macedonian, Russian, Serbian and Ukrainian. This entry-level cross-family evidence is used as an authority check, not as raw token-volume voting.
evidence.protected_domains: The target is ordinary running prose. It is not in a comment, foreign title, bibliography identity, TeX control name, citation key, label, formula or proper name.

validation.coverage: Exactly one whole-token ljubazno exists across all four Latin sources, at the declared base locator.
validation.postcondition: Whole-token ljubazno becomes zero and official ljubezno becomes one.
validation.structure: Line count, raw brace counts, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream are invariant; the other three source files are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The exact predecessor and successor bytes and SHA-256 values are frozen in the deterministic applicator.
